title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Who partners with who
hook: How do you pick partners for drills?
intro: The same two players get left for last.
statement: Partners shape how much a kid learns.
q1: Do you pair stronger players with newer ones —
q2: or pair players at the same level?
q3: How does it feel to be picked last?
t1: Every team is different. But everyone improves
t2: when partners are chosen with care.
cta: Coaches — how do you pick partners?
ctaLines: Mixed levels. Same levels. Number off.
ctaPrompt: Share your partner habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How do you pick partners for drills?
Kids pick their friends. The same two players get left for last.
Partners shape how much a kid learns.
Mixed skill levels or matched. Both can work.
How do you pick partners? Share your habit in the comments.
